title: Reports
description: What people reported on public pages, from every company. Open reports come first.

help.title: About Reports
help.overview: Anyone signed in can report a listing, a review, a business or another public thing. Every report lands here, in the platform company. The reported business never learns who sent it.

sections.title: Deciding
items: Open a report's menu and choose Decide. You can dismiss it, hide the reported thing, hide the business from the portal, suspend the business, or ban the account that wrote it.
A decision closes every open report about the same thing.
A suspended business can't sign in, its sites go offline and nothing is emailed on its behalf. A banned account can't sign in anywhere.
Everything except a dismissal can be undone from the same menu.

sections.title: Who sees this page
items: Only the platform company, and only people whose role allows deciding reports.
